items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 49:1
items.html: For the male, who is MA, has a root also from BON that belongs to the female, since he bestows the BON upon the female, hence the root necessarily remains in him, as is known. But the female has only BON, which is her own part, while from MA she has only an illumination alone, and therefore her Daat is light, for she has only the five Gevurot from BON, and lacks the five Hassadim that are from MA. (Inner Light, page 620, Sub Header, “Her Daat”)
